faq.q: What is the best time for a photoshoot yacht session in Marbella?
faq.a: The golden hour, roughly 60-90 minutes before sunset, offers soft, warm light ideal for photography. In Marbella, this typically falls between 19:00 and 21:00 from May to September. Our sunset sessions are timed to maximise that window.

faq.q: Which yachts are available for a Marbella photoshoot?
faq.a: Our Tier A boats – the 12.5m Astondoa 40 (9 pax) and 12.5m Azimut 39 (11 pax) – are perfect for sunset shoots. Both depart from Puerto Banús and include a skipper, drinks, and snacks. For larger groups, inquire about our Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) via WhatsApp.

faq.q: What is included in the photoshoot yacht charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No extra costs – just turn up and shoot.

faq.q: Can I bring my own photographer or is one provided?
faq.a: You are welcome to bring your own photographer. We do not provide a photographer, but the yacht's open layout and flybridge offer ample space for professional shots. The skipper can also assist with positioning the boat for the best light.

faq.q: How do I book a sunset photoshoot session for 2036?
faq.a: Book directly via our website or WhatsApp. For the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, select the 2-hour or 8-hour package. For other yachts, contact us for pricing. All bookings require a deposit to secure the date.

faq.q: What is the cancellation policy for a photoshoot charter?
faq.a: We offer free cancellation up to 48 hours before departure. Within 48 hours, the deposit is non-refundable. Weather-related cancellations are handled case by case – we'll reschedule or refund if conditions are unsafe.

faq.q: Can I charter a larger yacht for a photoshoot?
faq.a: Yes. The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is available from €4,719 for a minimum 4 hours, and includes a free jet ski. Other options like the Ferretti 94 or Canados 86 are available on request via WhatsApp. Perfect for brand campaigns or group shoots.

faq.q: Where does the photoshoot yacht depart from?
faq.a: All our charters depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella's glamorous marina. You'll meet the crew at the designated berth 15 minutes before departure. The marina itself offers great pre-shoot backdrops.

data.body_html:
Capture the golden hour magic on a Marbella photoshoot yacht sunset session 2036. Whether you're an influencer, brand, or couple, chartering a private yacht from Puerto Banús at sunset delivers unparalleled light and luxury. Our Tier A boats – the 12.5m Astondoa 40 (9 pax) and 12.5m Azimut 39 (11 pax) – start at €749 for 2 hours, with skipper, drinks, and VAT included. No hidden costs, just you, the Mediterranean, and that perfect shot.

Why Choose a Marbella Photoshoot Yacht Sunset Session 2036?

Sunset in Marbella is a spectacle. The sky turns shades of orange, pink, and purple, reflecting off the calm sea. A yacht charter gives you an exclusive, floating studio with zero crowds. You control the angle, the backdrop, and the mood. Our sunset sessions are timed to maximise the golden hour – typically 19:00 to 21:00 from May to September.

Our Yachts for Sunset Photoshoots

We offer two ideal yachts for sunset shoots, both departing from Puerto Banús:

  • Astondoa 40 – 12.5m, 9 passengers. Open layout, spacious bow, and comfortable cockpit. Perfect for intimate shoots.
  • Azimut 39 – 12.5m, 11 passengers. Flybridge design offers elevated perspectives for shooting.

For larger groups or more luxurious backdrops, inquire about our Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) via WhatsApp – minimum 4 hours from €4,719, with a free jet ski included.

What's Included in Your Photoshoot Charter

Every booking includes: licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You just bring your camera and creativity. No surprise fees.

Tips for a Perfect Photoshoot on a Yacht

  • Arrive early: Meet the crew at Puerto Banús 15 minutes before departure.
  • Golden hour timing: Aim for 60-90 minutes before sunset. Our skipper can recommend the exact time.
  • Pack light: Bring only essentials – camera, lenses, props. The yacht has storage but space is limited.
  • Use the flybridge: The Azimut 39's flybridge offers great elevated shots.
  • Coordinate outfits: Neutral tones or white pop against the sunset. Avoid busy patterns.

Book Your Marbella Photoshoot Yacht Sunset Session 2036

Ready to capture the magic? Book your yacht charter online or via WhatsApp. For the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, choose the 2-hour or 8-hour package. For larger yachts, contact us for a custom quote. All charters include skipper, drinks, and VAT – no surprises.
